description: Lime Trees 39, 40 ,41, & 42 Crown lift to 3mLime Tree 44 crown lift to 5m. Robinia Trees 50, 51, 52 & 53 crown clean.Catalpa Tree 54 cut back to give 1 metre clear to buildings/seating area Cherry Tree 59 crown lift to 2.5m to clear highway and foot path. Reduce lateral branches opposite path on field side to balance and apply cobra brace to support limb.(TPO 09, 1970)
